description: This file defines data models, query parameters, and fetcher logic for retrieving Fama-French international index return data, including classes for query parameters, data representation, and data fetching with transformation and extraction methods.

classes.name: FamaFrenchInternationalIndexReturnsQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching international index return data, including options for index, measure, frequency, dividends, data completeness, and date range.

classes.name: FamaFrenchInternationalIndexReturnsData
classes.description: Represents the data structure for international index portfolio returns, including various financial ratios and metadata.

classes.name: FamaFrenchInternationalIndexReturnsFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and transforming international index return data, including query transformation, data extraction from external sources, and data processing.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a strongly typed query parameter object.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches data from the Fama-French FTP, calling an external helper function with parameters, and handling warnings and exceptions.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Processes raw data and metadata, cleans and filters data, and constructs a result object with detailed description.
